description: R3-05 independent-review FP (Track A3, gemini-4-neon-high): a write refusal (DELETE 403) on a resource is paired with a permitted public read (GET 200) on the same route for the same principal, with no confined repo slices. Tier-1 composite/claims verification and Tier-2 policy judge must both reject confirmation (method-mismatched refusal control cannot bypass the hard no-repo rule, and a non-confirmed / needs_review outcome must never compile a Verify Fix predicate or inflate confirmed counts).
